The main takeaway from our work is that
ClC‐7 is the first example for a slowly gating voltage‐dependent Cl−/H+-exchange.
ClC‐7 is an exchanger that is activated by depolarization and inactivates upon repolarization, which is in contrast to other Cl−/H+-exchangers that are activated by hyperpolarization.
